# HttpProtect.isBanned() method

Whether an address is currently on the block list.

**Signature:**

```typescript
isBanned(ip: string): Promise<boolean>;
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;boolean&gt;

`true` if it is banned.

## Exceptions

TypeError if `ip` is not a valid address, including an empty string.

## Remarks

Asynchronous, and it reloads the entire block list to answer — via [HttpProtect.bannedNetworks()](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect.bannednetworks/)<!-- -->, whose IPv6 over-match it inherits, so this can return `true` for an IPv6 address that was never banned. For IPv4 it is exact.
